quizzes.title: Primary Science & General Knowledge Starter
quizzes.subject: General Science
quizzes.description: Sample starter quiz for classroom Snake & Ladder arena games.

questions.question: Which gas do plants release during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis uses sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to produce glucose and oxygen.

questions.question: Sound travels faster in solids than in air.
questions.explanation: Molecules in solids are packed tightly together, allowing sound waves to transfer energy rapidly.

questions.question: What is the boiling point of pure water at standard atmospheric pressure in degrees Celsius?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius under standard atmospheric pressure.
